title: a plain `break label` that would complete a value block without its value is rejected
notes: specification/control-flow.mdx, 'Blocks' and 'Labeled Break Values': an expression block produces a value 'from its final expression or from a labeled value break', and 'The compiler MUST combine reachable break values when determining the labeled expression's type.' A plain `break verdict` is a reachable exit that carries no value, so the construct has no statically determined type on that path — specification/control-flow.mdx, 'Expression Forms', requires one. Fail-closed: the alternative is a value block that silently yields undefined. 12-labeled-block-values/labeled-block-may-complete-without-a-value pins the fallthrough variant of the same rule.
